description.text: Defeat Sharia Law in America Act

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

bill.policyArea: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
bill.title: Defeat Sharia Law in America Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill adds to the Civil Rights Act that a public accommodation implementing Sharia law in delivering goods or services constitutes religious discrimination. It applies to establishments covered by Section 201(a) of the Act.

impact.summary: The bill adds that public accommodations implementing Sharia law commit religious discrimination under the Civil Rights Act. It would cover hotels, restaurants, stores and hospitals, affect Muslim owned businesses and Islamic charities offering public services, and enable DOJ and private Civil Rights Act suits.
